name: sanchalan
sourceVersion: V1.0 (source explicitly says not guaranteed final executable version)

rules.name: verse-boundary
rules.rule: A verse body ends at ॥N॥ where N is an ASCII or Devanagari decimal number.

rules.name: unicode-normalization
rules.rule: Normalize recognized input to NFC; preserve the normalized verse text and code-point offsets.

rules.name: longest-lexeme
rules.rule: At each code-point offset, choose the longest lexicon entry that matches.

rules.name: residual-preservation
rules.rule: Unmatched spans are retained verbatim and make the verse partial; they are never deleted or guessed.

rules.name: sequence-validation
rules.rule: Verse numbers are reported in source order; duplicates and gaps are diagnostics, not silently repaired.

rules.name: lexical-status
rules.rule: LEXICALLY_COMPLETE means no residual text; LEXICALLY_PARTIAL means residual text exists. Neither status asserts grammatical validity.

rules.name: visarga-scu
rules.rule: श्च after a matched stem is ḥ+c, licensed by 8.3.34 then 8.4.40. It is consumed only at that boundary.

rules.name: execute-named-ops
rules.rule: Only recognized operation codes execute. Residual text does not execute.
